fix_commit.message: Fix a typo in [0819fe670f9ceec7] that lead to incomplete protection against buffer overflow in the zipfile extension. [forum:/forumpost/2025-12-30T23:57:19z|Forum post 2025-12-30T23:57:19z]
fix_commit.author: drh

findings.title: Wrong size constant in bounds check allows out-of-bounds read in zipfile extension
findings.message: In zipfileGetEntry(), when reading Central Directory Structure (CDS) entries from a blob (in-memory ZIP), the bounds check uses ZIPFILE_LFH_FIXED_SZ (30) instead of ZIPFILE_CDS_FIXED_SZ (46). The pointer aRead is set to &aBlob[iOff + ZIPFILE_CDS_FIXED_SZ] (i.e., offset +46), but the bounds check only verifies iOff + ZIPFILE_LFH_FIXED_SZ + nFile + nExtra > nBlob (i.e., offset +30). This 16-byte discrepancy means that when nBlob - iOff - nFile - nExtra falls between 30 and 45 inclusive, the bounds check passes but the subsequent read starting at offset iOff+46 (and extending through nFile+nExtra bytes) is out of bounds, causing a heap buffer overread.
findings.suggestion: Replace ZIPFILE_LFH_FIXED_SZ with ZIPFILE_CDS_FIXED_SZ in the bounds check so that the verified range matches the actual accessor offset. The check must account for the CDS fixed-size header (46 bytes) at which aRead starts, not the LFH fixed-size header (30 bytes).

ground_truth.root_cause: A copy-paste or naming mistake in the newly added bounds check: the developer wrote ZIPFILE_LFH_FIXED_SZ (the Local File Header constant, value 30) when the intent was ZIPFILE_CDS_FIXED_SZ (the Central Directory Structure constant, value 46). Since aRead is placed at iOff + ZIPFILE_CDS_FIXED_SZ (offset 46), the safety guard must use that same constant to correctly bound the subsequent read of nFile+nExtra bytes.
